Start pull Logic Apps enabled.

Write standard events to a Log Analytics custom table (AzureAlertEvents_CL).
Existing workspace in the central resource group for the sink; empty = create one.
M4: VM CPU threshold in percent.
M4: data disk bandwidth consumed threshold in percent.
Feishu rate limiting (code 11232 / HTTP 429): attempts per message before it is recorded as failed; the wait grows with each attempt (8 attempts take about 10 minutes).

metadata.description: Existing workspace in this resource group; empty = create one.
Service Health event types to alert on.

variables.$fxv#0:
servicehealthresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/events'
| extend p = properties
| extend lu = datetime(0001-01-01) + tolong(p.LastUpdateTime) * 1tick, st = datetime(0001-01-01) + tolong(p.ImpactStartTime) * 1tick, mtRaw = datetime(0001-01-01) + tolong(p.ImpactMitigationTime) * 1tick
| where lu > ago(__LOOKBACK__)
| extend eventType = tostring(p.EventType)
| where eventType in (__EVENT_TYPES__)
| extend trackingId = tostring(p.TrackingId), status = tostring(p.Status), level = tostring(p.EventLevel), subType = tostring(p.EventSubType), tags = tostring(p.EventTags),
    mt = iff(mtRaw > datetime(2000-01-01), mtRaw, datetime(null)), evTitle = tostring(p.Title), summaryHtml = iff(strlen(tostring(p.Description)) > strlen(tostring(p.Summary)), tostring(p.Description), tostring(p.Summary)), impact = tostring(p.Impact),
    sensitive = tostring(p.isEventSensitive)
| extend fp = hash_sha256(strcat(status, '|', tags, '|', tostring(mt), '|', tostring(p.Description), '|', summaryHtml))
| summarize subs = make_set(subscriptionId), lu = max(lu), titles = make_set(evTitle), summaries = make_set(summaryHtml), impacts = make_set(impact), sens = make_set(sensitive)
    by trackingId, fp, eventType, status, level, subType, tags, st, mt
| extend evTitle = tostring(titles[0]), summaryHtml = tostring(summaries[0]), impactAll = replace_string(strcat_array(impacts, ','), @'\\', @'\'), sensitive = tostring(sens[0])
| join kind=leftouter (
    servicehealthresources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/events/impactedresources'
    | extend irTracking = tostring(split(tostring(split(id, '/events/')[1]), '/')[0])
    | summarize irCount = count(), irList = make_set(strcat(tostring(properties.resourceGroup), '/', tostring(properties.resourceName)), 10) by irTracking
  ) on $left.trackingId == $right.irTracking
| extend services = extract_all(@'"ImpactedService":"([^"]+)"', impactAll), regions = extract_all(@'"ImpactedRegion":"([^"]+)"', impactAll)
| extend summary = trim(@'\s+', replace_regex(replace_regex(replace_regex(replace_string(replace_string(summaryHtml, ' ', ' '), '&', '&'), @'<(br|/p|/li|/h[1-6])[^>]*>', '\n'), @'<[^>]+>', ''), @'\n\s*\n+', '\n'))
| extend updateType = case(status =~ 'Resolved', 'Resolved', tags contains 'PIR', 'PIR', isnotnull(mt) and mt <= now(), 'Mitigated', 'Active')
| extend severity = case(level in~ ('Critical', 'Error'), 'Critical', level =~ 'Warning' or eventType == 'SecurityAdvisory', 'Warning', 'Informational')
| extend eventId = strcat('sh:', trackingId, ':', substring(fp, 0, 16))
| extend event = pack(
    'schemaVersion', '1.0',
    'eventId', eventId,
    'source', pack('module', 'M1-ServiceHealth', 'channel', 'ARG', 'rawId', trackingId),
    'category', strcat('ServiceHealth.', eventType),
    'severity', severity,
    'status', iff(status =~ 'Resolved', 'Resolved', 'Updated'),
    'initiator', 'Platform',
    'title', strcat(trackingId, ' ', trim(@'\s+', evTitle)),
    'summary', summary,
    'time', pack('eventTime', lu, 'impactStartTime', st),
    'impacted', pack('subscriptions', subs, 'services', set_union(services, dynamic([])), 'regions', set_union(regions, dynamic([])), 'resourceCount', irCount, 'resources', irList),
    'details', pack('trackingId', trackingId, 'eventType', eventType, 'eventSubType', subType, 'eventLevel', level, 'updateType', updateType,
        'eventTags', tags, 'impactMitigationTime', mt, 'isEventSensitive', sensitive),
    'display', pack_array(
        pack('k', '状态', 'v', case(updateType == 'Resolved', '已恢复', updateType == 'PIR', '事后复盘（PIR）', updateType == 'Mitigated' and eventType in ('HealthAdvisory', 'SecurityAdvisory', 'Billing'), '已过截止日期', updateType == 'Mitigated', '已缓解', eventType in ('HealthAdvisory', 'SecurityAdvisory', 'Billing'), '生效中', '进行中')),
        pack('k', '子类型', 'v', case(subType == 'Retirement', '退役通知', subType == 'PriceChanges', '价格变更', subType)),
        pack('k', '影响服务', 'v', strcat_array(set_union(services, dynamic([])), '、')),
        pack('k', '受影响资源', 'v', iff(isnull(irCount) or irCount == 0, '', strcat(tostring(irCount), ' 个：', strcat_array(irList, '、'), iff(irCount > 10, ' 等', '')))),
        pack('k', '影响开始（北京时间）', 'v', iff(st > datetime(2000-01-01), format_datetime(st + 8h, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), '')),
        pack('k', '缓解 / 截止（北京时间）', 'v', iff(isnull(mt), '', format_datetime(mt + 8h, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')))),
    'links', pack('portal', strcat('https://app.azure.com/h/', trackingId)))
| project eventId, event

$fxv#0.description: Project Flash annotation classification. names are matched exactly after stripping the LiveMigrationEligible/LiveMigrationNotEligible suffix (case-insensitive). summaryKeywords are only used when the change record carries no annotationName (same name as the previous annotation) and the snapshot cannot fill it; they mirror keywords validated against real annotation data. Rules are evaluated in order.

variables.$fxv#1:
healthresourcechanges
| where properties.targetResourceType =~ 'microsoft.resourcehealth/resourceannotations'
| extend ts = todatetime(properties.changeAttributes.timestamp)
| where ts > ago(__LOOKBACK__)
| where not(tostring(properties.targetResourceId) contains '/virtualMachineScaleSets/')
| extend ridOrig = tostring(split(tostring(properties.targetResourceId), '/providers/Microsoft.ResourceHealth/resourceAnnotations/current')[0])
| extend c = properties.changes
| project rid = tolower(ridOrig), ridOrig, tsKey = strcat(format_datetime(ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), 'T', format_datetime(ts, 'HH:mm:ss.fff')), ts, chgId = id,
    cName = tostring(split(tostring(c['properties.annotationName'].newValue), '//')[0]), cSummary = tostring(c['properties.summary'].newValue),
    cReason = tostring(c['properties.reason'].newValue), cContext = tostring(c['properties.context'].newValue),
    cImpact = tostring(c['properties.impactType'].newValue), cCat = tostring(c['properties.category'].newValue)
| project rid, ridOrig, tsKey, chgId, name = cName, summary = cSummary, reason = cReason, context = cContext, impact = cImpact, flashCat = cCat
| extend base = replace_regex(name, @'LiveMigration(Not)?Eligible$', ''), lmElig = extract(@'LiveMigration((Not)?Eligible)$', 1, name)
| extend category = case(__CATEGORY__, '')
| where isnotempty(category)
| extend severity = case(__SEVERITY__, 'Warning'), initiator = case(__INITIATOR__, 'Platform')
| extend subId = tostring(split(rid, '/')[2]), isVmss = rid contains '/virtualmachinescalesets/'
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.network/networkinterfaces' and isnotempty(properties.virtualMachine.id)
    | project vmid = tolower(tostring(properties.virtualMachine.id)), ipcs = properties.ipConfigurations, nicLoc = location
    | mv-expand ipc = ipcs limit 400
    | summarize privateIPs = make_set(tostring(ipc.properties.privateIPAddress)), locs = make_set(nicLoc) by vmid
  ) on $left.rid == $right.vmid
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subId = subscriptionId, subName = name) on subId
| extend parts = split(ridOrig, '/')
| extend vmName = iff(isVmss, strcat(tostring(parts[8]), '_', tostring(parts[10])), tostring(parts[8])), rg = tostring(parts[4])
| extend eventId = strcat('flash:', rid, '|', tsKey)
| extend event = pack(
    'schemaVersion', '1.0',
    'eventId', eventId,
    'source', pack('module', 'M2-Flash', 'channel', 'ARG', 'rawId', chgId),
    'category', category,
    'severity', severity,
    'status', 'New',
    'initiator', initiator,
    'title', strcat(vmName, '：', iff(isempty(reason), iff(isempty(name), '平台事件', name), reason)),
    'summary', summary,
    'time', pack('eventTime', strcat(tsKey, 'Z')),
    'resource', pack('id', ridOrig, 'type', iff(isVmss, 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets/virtualmachines', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'), 'name', vmName,
        'subscriptionId', subId, 'subscriptionName', subName, 'resourceGroup', rg, 'region', tostring(locs[0])),
    'details', pack('annotationName', name, 'liveMigrationEligibility', lmElig, 'reason', reason, 'impactType', impact, 'context', context, 'flashCategory', flashCat),
    'enrichment', pack('privateIPs', privateIPs, 'vmssName', iff(isVmss, tostring(parts[8]), '')),
    'display', pack_array(
        pack('k', '平台事件', 'v', iff(isempty(name), '（变更记录未带名称，按描述归类）', name)),
        pack('k', '影响', 'v', case(impact == 'Downtime Reboot', '停机重启', impact == 'Downtime Freeze', '短暂冻结', impact == 'Degraded', '性能降级', impact == 'Informational', '无影响（仅通知）', impact)),
        pack('k', '发起方', 'v', case(context contains 'Platform', '平台', context contains 'VM', '虚拟机自身', context contains 'Customer' or context contains 'User', '用户', context)),
        pack('k', '热迁移', 'v', case(lmElig == 'Eligible', '支持（平台会尝试热迁移）', lmElig == 'NotEligible', '不支持（建议尽快重新部署）', '')),
        pack('k', '私网 IP', 'v', strcat_array(privateIPs, '、'))),
    'links', pack('portal', strcat('https://portal.azure.com/#@/resource', ridOrig, '/resourceHealth')))
| project eventId, event

metadata.description: Usage bands in percent, ascending. The highest band is reported as Critical, the others as Warning.
Hours after which an unchanged band is reported again.

variables.$fxv#0:
quotaresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.compute/locations/usages'
| mv-expand q = properties.value limit 400
| extend cur = todouble(q.currentValue), lim = todouble(q['limit']), qname = tostring(q.name.value), qdisp = tostring(q.name.localizedValue)
| where lim > 0
| extend pct = round(100.0 * cur / lim, 1)
| extend band = case(__BAND_CASE__, 0)
| where band > 0
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subscriptionId, subName = name) on subscriptionId
| extend eventId = strcat('quota:', subscriptionId, ':', location, ':', qname, ':', tostring(band))
| extend event = pack(
    'schemaVersion', '1.0',
    'eventId', eventId,
    'source', pack('module', 'M5-Quota', 'channel', 'ARG', 'rawId', id),
    'category', 'Quota.Compute',
    'severity', iff(band >= __CRITICAL_BAND__, 'Critical', 'Warning'),
    'status', 'New',
    'initiator', 'Customer',
    'title', strcat(qdisp, '（', location, '）使用率 ', tostring(pct), '%'),
    'summary', strcat('已使用 ', tostring(cur), ' / ', tostring(lim), '，达到 ', tostring(band), '% 档位。持续高于该档位时约每天提醒一次，升到更高档位时立即提醒。'),
    'time', pack('eventTime', now()),
    'resource', pack('id', strcat('/subscriptions/', subscriptionId), 'type', 'microsoft.compute/locations/usages', 'name', qdisp,
        'subscriptionId', subscriptionId, 'subscriptionName', subName, 'region', location),
    'details', pack('quotaName', qname, 'currentValue', cur, 'limit', lim, 'percent', pct, 'band', band),
    'display', pack_array(
        pack('k', '已用 / 上限', 'v', strcat(tostring(cur), ' / ', tostring(lim))),
        pack('k', '配额名称', 'v', qname)),
    'links', pack('portal', 'https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_Azure_Capacity/QuotaMenuBlade/~/myQuotas'))
| project eventId, event

metadata.description: Event statuses to alert on. Scheduled = advance notice (only when the event is not auto-approved), Started / Completed / Canceled = progress.
Also alert on user-initiated events (e.g. az vm restart / redeploy).

variables.$fxv#0:
maintenanceresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.maintenance/scheduledevents'
| extend p = properties
| extend evType = tostring(p.EventType), st = tostring(p.EventStatus), src = tostring(p.EventSource), eid = tostring(p.EventId),
    notBeforeRaw = tostring(p.NotBefore), dur = toint(p.DurationInSeconds), descr = tostring(p.Description), targets = p.Resources
| where st in (__STATUSES__)
| where src in (__SOURCES__)
| extend rid = tostring(split(id, '/providers/microsoft.maintenance/')[0])
| extend parts = split(rid, '/')
| extend isVmss = rid contains '/virtualmachinescalesets/', rg = tostring(parts[4]), subId = tostring(parts[2]), targetName = tostring(parts[8])
| extend notBefore = todatetime(notBeforeRaw)
| extend typeCn = case(evType == 'Reboot', '重启', evType == 'Redeploy', '重新部署', evType == 'Freeze', '冻结', evType == 'Preempt', '抢占（Spot 驱逐）', evType == 'Terminate', '终止', evType),
    stCn = case(st == 'Scheduled', '已计划', st == 'Started', '已开始', st == 'Completed', '已完成', st == 'Canceled', '已取消', st),
    srcCn = case(src == 'Platform', '平台', src == 'User', '用户', src)
| extend eventId = strcat('se:', eid, ':', st)
| extend event = pack(
    'schemaVersion', '1.0',
    'eventId', eventId,
    'source', pack('module', 'M6-ScheduledEvents', 'channel', 'ARG', 'rawId', id),
    'category', strcat('ScheduledEvent.', evType),
    'severity', case(src == 'User', 'Informational', evType in ('Reboot', 'Redeploy', 'Preempt', 'Terminate') and st in ('Scheduled', 'Started'), 'Warning', 'Informational'),
    'status', iff(st in ('Completed', 'Canceled'), 'Resolved', 'New'),
    'initiator', iff(src == 'User', 'Customer', 'Platform'),
    'title', strcat(targetName, '：', typeCn, ' ', stCn),
    'summary', strcat(descr, iff(isnull(notBefore), '', strcat('（最早开始时间 ', format_datetime(notBefore + 8h, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), ' 北京时间）'))),
    'time', pack('eventTime', iff(isnull(notBefore), now(), notBefore)),
    'resource', pack('id', rid, 'type', iff(isVmss, 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachinescalesets', 'microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'), 'name', targetName,
        'subscriptionId', subId, 'resourceGroup', rg, 'region', location),
    'details', pack('eventId', eid, 'eventType', evType, 'eventStatus', st, 'eventSource', src, 'notBefore', notBeforeRaw, 'durationInSeconds', dur, 'resources', targets),
    'display', pack_array(
        pack('k', '状态', 'v', stCn),
        pack('k', '发起方', 'v', srcCn),
        pack('k', '预计影响时长', 'v', iff(isnull(dur) or dur <= 0, '', strcat(tostring(dur), ' 秒'))),
        pack('k', '受影响实例', 'v', strcat_array(targets, '、'))),
    'links', pack('portal', strcat('https://portal.azure.com/#@/resource', rid, '/overview')))
| project eventId, event
variables.query: [replace(replace(variables('$fxv#0'), '__STATUSES__', join(map(parameters('statuses'), lambda('s', format('''{0}''', lambdaVariables('s')))), ', ')), '__SOURCES__', join(map(variables('sources'), lambda('s', format('''{0}''', lambdaVariables('s')))), ', '))]

metadata.description: Event kinds to alert on: OutOfSupport (weekly reminder), EOLSoon (2 weeks / 1 week before EOL), UpgradeScheduled (pre-notice), UpgradeNotSucceeded (failed / canceled), UpgradeSkipped (skipped, e.g. cluster stopped), Routine (started / succeeded).

variables.$fxv#0:
containerserviceeventresources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters/scheduledevents'
| extend p = properties
| extend lu = todatetime(p.lastUpdateTime)
| where lu > ago(__LOOKBACK__)
| extend src = tostring(p.eventSource), descr = tostring(p.description), st = tostring(p.eventStatus), detailsRaw = tostring(p.eventDetails),
    cluster = tostring(p.resources[0]), eid = tostring(p.eventId), sched = todatetime(p.scheduledTime)
| extend d = iff(detailsRaw startswith '{', parse_json(detailsRaw), dynamic({}))
| extend upType = iff(detailsRaw startswith '{', tostring(d.type), coalesce(extract(@'of type: (\w+)', 1, detailsRaw), detailsRaw)), upStatus = tostring(d.status), err = tostring(d.error_message),
    eolDate = tostring(d.eolDate), k8sVersion = tostring(d.kubernetesVersion)
| extend evKind = case(
    src == 'EOLNotification' and descr == 'KubernetesVersionOutOfSupport', 'OutOfSupport',
    src == 'EOLNotification', 'EOLSoon',
    st == 'Scheduled', 'UpgradeScheduled',
    st in~ ('Failed', 'Canceled', 'Cancelled'), 'UpgradeNotSucceeded',
    st == 'Completed' and upStatus =~ 'Skipped', 'UpgradeSkipped',
    st == 'Completed' and isnotempty(upStatus) and upStatus !in~ ('Succeeded', 'Success'), 'UpgradeNotSucceeded',
    'Routine')
| where evKind in (__KINDS__)
| extend upTypeCn = case(upType == 'K8sVersionUpgrade', 'Kubernetes 版本升级', upType == 'NodeOSUpgrade', '节点 OS 升级', upType),
    stCn = case(st == 'Scheduled', '已计划', st == 'Started', '已开始', st == 'Completed', '已结束', st =~ 'Failed', '失败', st in~ ('Canceled', 'Cancelled'), '已取消', st),
    upStatusCn = case(upStatus =~ 'Skipped', '已跳过', upStatus =~ 'Failed', '失败', upStatus in~ ('Succeeded', 'Success'), '成功', upStatus)
| extend clusterName = tostring(split(cluster, '/')[8]), subId = tostring(split(cluster, '/')[2]), rg = tostring(split(cluster, '/')[4])
| join kind=leftouter (resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project subId = subscriptionId, subName = name) on subId
| extend eventId = case(
    evKind == 'OutOfSupport', strcat('aks:', tolower(cluster), ':oos:', format_datetime(startofweek(now()), 'yyyy-MM-dd')),
    evKind == 'EOLSoon', strcat('aks:', tolower(cluster), ':', descr, ':', eolDate),
    strcat('aks:', eid, ':', st, ':', upStatus))
| extend event = pack(
    'schemaVersion', '1.0',
    'eventId', eventId,
    'source', pack('module', 'M8-AKS', 'channel', 'ARG', 'rawId', eid),
    'category', iff(src == 'EOLNotification', 'AKS.VersionEOL', 'AKS.Upgrade'),
    'severity', case(evKind in ('OutOfSupport', 'EOLSoon'), 'Warning', evKind == 'UpgradeNotSucceeded' and upStatus !~ 'Skipped', 'Warning', 'Informational'),
    'status', 'New',
    'initiator', 'Platform',
    'title', strcat(clusterName, '：', case(src == 'EOLNotification', strcat('Kubernetes ', k8sVersion, iff(descr == 'KubernetesVersionOutOfSupport', ' 已超出支持期', ' 即将结束支持')), strcat(upTypeCn, ' ', stCn, iff(isempty(upStatusCn), '', strcat('（', upStatusCn, '）'))))),
    'summary', case(
        src == 'EOLNotification', strcat('Kubernetes ', k8sVersion, ' 的支持结束日期为 ', substring(eolDate, 0, 10), '，请规划升级。'),
        isnotempty(err), strcat(upTypeCn, ' ', stCn, iff(isempty(upStatusCn), '', strcat('（', upStatusCn, '）')), '：', err),
        strcat(upTypeCn, ' ', stCn, '。')),
    'time', pack('eventTime', iff(src != 'EOLNotification' and isnotnull(sched) and sched > datetime(2000-01-01), sched, lu), 'lastUpdateTime', lu),
    'resource', pack('id', cluster, 'type', 'microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters', 'name', clusterName, 'subscriptionId', subId, 'subscriptionName', subName, 'resourceGroup', rg),
    'details', pack('eventSource', src, 'description', descr, 'eventStatus', st, 'upgradeType', upType, 'upgradeStatus', upStatus, 'error', err, 'eventDetails', detailsRaw),
    'display', pack_array(
        pack('k', '计划时间（北京时间）', 'v', iff(isnotnull(sched) and sched > datetime(2000-01-01) and src != 'EOLNotification', format_datetime(sched + 8h, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), '')),
        pack('k', '维护窗口（UTC）', 'v', iff(isempty(tostring(d.window_open_time)), '', strcat(tostring(d.window_open_time), ' ~ ', tostring(d.window_close_time)))),
        pack('k', '支持结束日期', 'v', iff(isempty(eolDate), '', substring(eolDate, 0, 10))),
        pack('k', 'Kubernetes 版本', 'v', k8sVersion)),
    'links', pack('portal', strcat('https://portal.azure.com/#@/resource', cluster, '/overview')))
| project eventId, event

metadata.description: Scope watched by the rules. Empty = the whole subscription; set to a resource group id to limit (used for testing).
M3: activity log levels to alert on. Critical = platform-initiated unavailability.
M3: event statuses to alert on. Updated (progress updates of an ongoing event) is left out.
M4: regions to create the multi-resource VM metric rules in (one rule per region).
M4: VM Percentage CPU threshold (average over 5 minutes). The platform metric may never reach 100 on some sizes (measured 83.3% max on D2s_v5).
M4: VM Data Disk Bandwidth Consumed Percentage threshold (average over 5 minutes, per LUN).
M7: activity log levels to alert on (Administrative category, all resource types and operations). Add Warning to also get policy audit and similar events.
M7: optional operation filter; empty = every operation.

properties.description: azure-alert M3: Resource Health events of level Critical (not Updated) for all resource types.
azure-alert M7: Administrative activity log events of level Error / Critical (all resource types and operations).
[format('azure-alert M4: VM Percentage CPU >= {0}% (average over 5 minutes).', parameters('cpuThreshold'))]
[format('azure-alert M4: VM Data Disk Bandwidth Consumed Percentage >= {0}% (average over 5 minutes, per LUN).', parameters('dataDiskBandwidthThreshold'))]
